pages.title: Mavkas
pages.text: $(bold)How to win favour.$() Kill a Chuhaister in front of the mavkas. Every mavka that watched from nearby (within 24 blocks) will accept you as a friend.$(br2)$(bold)A gift.$() Give a friendly Mavka a $(item)Wither Rose$(): in return you receive Regeneration II for five minutes.

pages.title: Wither Rose
pages.text: Hand it to the Mavka or toss it nearby: she will walk over, pick up the flower and say thanks.$(br2)$(#A33B3B)Striking a Mavka ends the friendship.$() She will treat you as an enemy again.

pages.title: Nichnytsias
pages.text: $(bold)A gift with a soul.$() Offer a $(item)Crystallized Soul$() to a Nichnytsia or toss it near her. She accepts and throws a helpful potion at you: saturation, regeneration, absorption, resistance, speed, strength or instant health.$(br2)$(#8A6A1A)The peace lasts five minutes$(), after which she is hostile again.

pages.title: Crystallized Soul
pages.text: Combine a soul captured with a Soul Catcher with amethyst. More about it is in the Diary.
